dialogues.speaker: Latkin
dialogues.text: Ah... Forgive me, I didn't mean to disturb you. I'm searching for some medical records.

dialogues.speaker: Latkin
dialogues.text: It's for my daughter... She suffers from a rare disease. The moment she leaves the tundra, her consciousness begins to slip away just like melting snowflakes.

dialogues.speaker: Latkin
dialogues.text: And this is even the best that the kind Augury Bird couple could achieve after treating my daughter for over a decade. If they hadn't taken Mirria in right after she was born, she would have...

dialogues.speaker: Latkin
dialogues.text: Even now, she still has to return to the countryside periodically to receive their treatment.

dialogues.speaker: Latkin
dialogues.text: That's why I'm seeking a way to cure her once and for all.

dialogues.speaker: Latkin
dialogues.text: Not just for Mirria, but for our other daughter... to whom we are so deeply indebted.
